status.$description: Three distinct treatments per role, not one. Solid: <name> fill + text.onBrand (white) — already AA in both themes, white-on-fill doesn't depend on background. Soft: <name>Subtle fill + on<Name> text, no border. Outline: on<Name> text + <name>Border border, on the page background — NOT on the Subtle fill. Border is only verified against bg.page (>=3:1); against its own Subtle fill it's 1.8-2.8:1, which is why outline and soft are two separate treatments rather than one badge that layers both. Badge (src/components/Badge.tsx) implements exactly this: its solid/soft/outline variants map 1:1 onto these three treatments, and no variant stacks Border on top of Subtle — that combination is not just undocumented, it's unreachable through Badge's props.
